messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D tactical shooter inspired by Counter-Strike: Global Offensive, supporting phones and tablets.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Verify with screenshots saved as small JPEGs, viewport no wider than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Built an original, lightweight canvas-based first-person shooter named BREACH, with a defuse mission, three AI hostiles, and responsive HUD/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the 3D-style arena, movement, aiming, shooting, reloading, hostile AI, health/armor, bomb timer, defusing, minimap, and win/lose screens.
- Added desktop keyboard/mouse controls and responsive touch controls.
- `node --check game.js` passed; launched via `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/gameplay.jpg` and mobile screenshots.

### Active
- Fix mobile joystick placement: browser evaluation at 390×844 reported `#stick-zone` at `(0,0)` with `position: static`, despite styles intended to position it at the lower-left; inspect CSS cascade/layout and re-check screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and correct `#touch-controls` / `#stick-zone` positioning on mobile; confirm joystick and fire/reload buttons fit within the screen.
2. Re-run browser checks and save/inspect a final mobile JPEG.
3. Review `git status`; changes are currently uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI and HUD markup.
- `style.css`: Desktop/mobile layout and touch control styles.
- `game.js`: Game logic, canvas rendering, and control handling.
- `screenshots/`: Gameplay and mobile JPEG captures.

## Important Context
- Browser check at 390×844 showed fire button at `(292,736)` and reload at `(237,770)`, but joystick was at `(0,0)`.
- Latest CSS is served by `localhost:3002`; reload browser after edits to avoid stale stylesheet.
